description: This Java class implements the XBRLResultService interface, providing functionality to compute and retrieve XBRL financial data summaries based on taxonomy mappings and database queries. It processes financial data within a specified date range, evaluates expressions for taxonomy values, and handles external dependencies such as database access and scripting for calculation.

classes.name: XBRLResultServiceImpl
classes.description: A Spring component implementing the XBRLResultService interface, responsible for retrieving and calculating XBRL taxonomy data based on database query results and predefined mappings.

methods.name: getXBRLResult
methods.description: Retrieves XBRL data results for a specific date range and currency by processing taxonomy mappings and database balances.

methods.name: retrieveTaxonomyConfig
methods.description: Fetches and processes the taxonomy mapping configuration, returning a map of taxonomy data to calculated BigDecimal values.

methods.name: getAccountSql
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string used to retrieve account balances within the specified date range.

methods.name: setupBalanceMap
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL to populate a map of glcode to account balance BigDecimal.

methods.name: processMappingString
methods.description: Calculates a BigDecimal value based on an expression string with placeholders for glcodes, evaluating the expression with embedded JavaScript engine.

methods.name: getGLCodes
methods.description: Extracts all glcode placeholders from a string template, returning a list of glcodes.
